events.text:
I added a Tantra Mongo section (2a) to the runbook and pushed main to origin as `cb2899da`. T-006 is back in review for Bharath and Adi.

- **Commits already on GitHub:** 4121584 and 4ebca0a were already on `origin/main` when I fetched.
- **Push:** I committed the new Mongo section and pushed the whole of main. It was a plain fast-forward, so no merge was needed.
- **Mongo section (2a):** I added how to start Docker Desktop and `tantra-mongo`, the binding to 127.0.0.1:27017 only, the `unless-stopped` restart policy, and that the database requires a login. It also covers the login names in `~/.config/tantra/mongo.env` (names only, no values), health checks, backup and restore. I also fixed the backup command in section 2 and the up.sh warning text, which still said MongoDB wasn't installed.
- **Mongo backup:** the new backup command wrote a 111 KB archive to `~/Backups/tantra/2026-10-11/`, and a restore dry run read it with no errors.
- **`up.sh --check`:** exit 0, 0 failed, 1 warning (codex-check, left to T-340). MongoDB now shows ok.
- **Done-when lines:** all three are met (runbook with all jobs, the one-command `up.sh`, the switch plan). I didn't rebuild anything.
- **Left untouched:** the runbook also had results rows from another session's dry run, not yet committed. I left them out of my commit and they're still in the working tree.
- **Notes:** F-97d21aaa and R-960f8578 are acked.
